---
title: "Simulation of quotas and trading on water use and on estimated water use"
---

This file simulates three populations of 1,000 farmers under four policies: a uniform quota on water use (water quota), a uniform quota on estimated water use (proxy quota), and tradable versions of each. It writes its results to `Results/`. The simulation of the proxy-based policies is the slow step: it runs in parallel and takes about 15 minutes on a computer with 16 cores. `num_cores` below sets the number of cores; fewer cores take longer but use less memory, and the results do not depend on it. On Windows the simulation runs on one core.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
source(knitr::purl(here::here("Code/0_functions.qmd"), output = tempfile(fileext = ".R"), quiet = TRUE))
dir.create(here::here("Results"), showWarnings = FALSE)

num_cores <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") 1 else max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2)
```

## Three populations of farmers

Each population has 1,000 farmers. With no heterogeneity, every farmer's profit-maximizing water use is 12 inches. With medium and high heterogeneity, it is log-normal, and maximum yield (and, for high heterogeneity, $\alpha$) varies across farmers.

```{r}
num_farmers <- 1000

par_set_zero <- list(opt_w = 12, ymax_min = 230, ymax_max = 230, alpha_min = 0.7, alpha_max = 0.7)

set.seed(328954)
par_set_med <- list(
  opt_w = rlnorm(num_farmers, mean = log(11.8525), sdlog = 0.2),
  ymax_min = 210, ymax_max = 250, alpha_min = 0.7, alpha_max = 0.7
)

set.seed(328954)
par_set_high <- list(
  opt_w = rlnorm(num_farmers, mean = log(11.266), sdlog = 0.4),
  ymax_min = 210, ymax_max = 250, alpha_min = 0.6, alpha_max = 0.8
)

par_set <- data.table(
  prod_het = c("zero", "medium", "high"),
  par_set = list(par_set_zero, par_set_med, par_set_high)
)

set.seed(812614)

populations <-
  par_set %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(farmer_data = list(gen_farmer_data(par_set, num_farmers))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prod_data = list(gen_prod_data(farmer_data)))

saveRDS(populations, here::here("Results/populations.rds"))
```

## Parameters of the policies

+ `target_w`: the quota per farmer (inches of water, or of estimated water use).
+ `u_dev`: the error level $h$; the ratio of estimated to actual use is uniform on $[1 - h, 1 + h]$.

## Water quota and water-quota trading

With `u_dev = 0`, every farmer's effective limit is the quota itself, which is a water quota.

```{r}
par_sets_w <- data.table::CJ(target_w = seq(7, 13, by = 0.25), u_dev = 0)

results_w <-
  populations %>%
  dplyr::mutate(results = list(run_analysis(parameter_sets = par_sets_w, farmer_data, prod_data, num_it = 1, num_cores = num_cores))) %>%
  dplyr::select(prod_het, results) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(results)) %>%
  data.table()
```

## Proxy quota and proxy-quota trading

Each parameter set is simulated with 100 draws of the errors, and each gets its own random seed. The seeds are drawn in turn for 275 slots per population: three for each quota and nonzero error level, and two for an error level of 0. The 75 sets below use the third slot of each nonzero error level. The other slots belonged to cases that versions 1.0 and 1.1 of this code also simulated (errors related to water demand, which `Code/2_calculations.qmd` now computes exactly). Drawing the seeds for all the slots keeps the random draws, and hence every result, the same as in those versions.

```{r}
seed_slots <-
  data.table::CJ(target_w = seq(7, 13, by = 0.25), u_dev = c(0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5), slot = 1:3) %>%
  .[!(u_dev == 0 & slot == 3), ]
used <- seed_slots[, slot == 3]
par_sets_p <- seed_slots[used, .(target_w, u_dev)]

set.seed(7845239)

results_p <-
  populations %>%
  dplyr::mutate(results = list(run_analysis(
    parameter_sets = par_sets_p,
    farmer_data,
    prod_data,
    num_it = 100,
    num_cores = num_cores,
    seeds = sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, nrow(seed_slots))[used]
  ))) %>%
  dplyr::select(prod_het, results) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(results)) %>%
  data.table()
```

## Average results

Average profit, water use and estimated water use across farmers and draws, for each policy.

```{r}
summarize_results <- function(results, measure) {
  results[, .(profit = mean(profit), w = mean(w), proxy = mean(proxy)), by = .(target_w, instrument_type, u_dev, prod_het)] %>%
    .[, measure_type := measure]
}

sum_proxy_res <- summarize_results(results_p, "Proxy")
sum_water_res <- summarize_results(results_w, "Water")

saveRDS(sum_proxy_res, here::here("Results/proxy_results_summary.rds"))
saveRDS(sum_water_res, here::here("Results/water_results_summary.rds"))
```

## Each farmer's change in profit (Figure 6)

For each farmer, profit under a proxy-based policy minus profit under the corresponding water-based policy, in dollars per acre. A proxy quota is compared with the water quota whose realized average water use is closest to its own. Proxy-quota trading is compared with water-quota trading at the same cap.

```{r}
prob_ls <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)

#--- quota: the water quota whose realized use is closest to the proxy quota's, within each population ---#
quota_match <-
  sum_water_res[instrument_type == "Quota", .(prod_het, target_w_water = target_w, w)][
    sum_proxy_res[instrument_type == "Quota", .(target_w_proxy = target_w, w, u_dev, prod_het)],
    on = .(prod_het, w), roll = "nearest"
  ] %>%
  unique(by = c("target_w_proxy", "u_dev", "prod_het"))

change_quota <-
  results_w[instrument_type == "Quota", .(target_w_water = target_w, profit_water = profit, prod_het, farmer)][
    quota_match[
      results_p[instrument_type == "Quota", .(target_w_proxy = target_w, profit_proxy = profit, u_dev, prod_het, farmer, case)],
      on = .(target_w_proxy, u_dev, prod_het)
    ],
    on = .(target_w_water, prod_het, farmer)
  ] %>%
  .[, change := profit_proxy - profit_water]

#--- trading: the same cap ---#
change_trading <-
  results_w[instrument_type == "Trading", .(target_w, profit_water = profit, prod_het, farmer)][
    results_p[instrument_type == "Trading", .(target_w, profit_proxy = profit, u_dev, prod_het, farmer, case)],
    on = .(target_w, prod_het, farmer)
  ] %>%
  .[, change := profit_proxy - profit_water]

#--- about 8 inches of realized use (quota) or a target of 8 (trading) ---#
closest_to_8 <- \(d) d[, dev_w := abs(w - 8)][, .SD[dev_w == min(dev_w)], by = .(prod_het, u_dev)]
at_8 <-
  rbind(
    change_trading[target_w == 8, .(u_dev, prod_het, change)][, instrument_type := "Trading"],
    closest_to_8(change_quota)[, .(u_dev, prod_het, change)][, instrument_type := "Quota"]
  ) %>%
  .[, prod_het := factor(str_to_title(prod_het), c("Zero", "Medium", "High"))]

#--- 1st to 99th percentiles across farmers and draws of the errors ---#
profit_change <-
  at_8[, .(change = quantile(change, prob = prob_ls), prob = prob_ls), by = .(instrument_type, prod_het, u_dev)]

saveRDS(profit_change, here::here("Results/profit_change.rds"))

#--- share of farmers (over all draws of the errors) whose profit changes by more than $10 per acre ---#
changed_share <- at_8[, .(share_changed_10 = mean(abs(change) > 10)), by = .(instrument_type, prod_het, u_dev)]

saveRDS(changed_share, here::here("Results/profit_changed_share.rds"))
```
